installer.label: Climate
installer.title: Connect Spider Farmer
installer.line: Email and password only. Google or Apple sign-in will not work.

spider_farmer_connected.title: Spider Farmer connected
spider_farmer_connected.body: The controller was saved. The climate sidecar reloads on its own.

spider_farmer_missing.title: Email and password required
spider_farmer_missing.body: Enter the Spider Farmer email and password.

spider_farmer_bad_password.title: Password rejected
spider_farmer_bad_password.body: Spider Farmer did not accept that password.

spider_farmer_unknown_account.title: Account not registered
spider_farmer_unknown_account.body: That email is not a Spider Farmer account. Sign in with Apple cannot be used here.

spider_farmer_failed.title: Spider Farmer login failed
spider_farmer_failed.body: Could not log in or save the sidecar env. Review logs and try again.

spider_farmer_choose.title: Choose a controller
spider_farmer_choose.body: This account has more than one controller. Pick the climate controller and log in again.

spider_farmer_no_controller.title: No controller found
spider_farmer_no_controller.body: Spider Farmer accepted the login and returned no controllers.
